complexity.rationale: A new interactive component with month-grid date logic, local state, keyboard and assistive-technology behaviour, and a HomeView change. No shared state, API or dependency change.

capabilityOwners.rationale: Selected date and visible month are component-local UI concerns.
No other component needs the selection; the card asks only to display it in the widget.

unit.rationale: Month-grid construction (leading blanks, month lengths, leap February) and the date label are branching logic worth isolating.

component.rationale: Selecting a date, month navigation, marking and the displayed text are the user-observable behaviour.

integration.rationale: No cross-module behaviour; the HomeView component test renders the real CalendarWidget.

e2e.rationale: Self-contained widget with no navigation, network or persistence; component tests exercise the full interaction.

increments.behavior: A pure helper builds a month grid (weeks of day-or-blank cells, Sunday start) for a year and month, and formats a selected date as an en-US long label.
CalendarWidget renders a labelled month grid with previous and next month buttons; activating a day marks it selected and shows its date as text, starting from 'No date selected'.
HomeView renders the calendar widget after the torus row, leaving the other sections unchanged.
increments.doneWhen: The HomeView component test passes, and the full unit and component suites, lint and build still pass.

tests.description: src/lib/calendarMonth.unit.test.ts: buildMonthGrid returns rows of 7 cells with the first day under the right weekday (leading blanks), the right number of days for 30- and 31-day months, 29 days for February 2024 and 28 for February 2026, and trailing blanks filling the last week; formatSelectedDate(new Date(2026, 10, 25)) is 'Wednesday, November 25, 2026'.

CalendarWidget (src/components/calendar-widget/CalendarWidget.component.test.tsx, fake timers pin 'today'): region named 'Calendar'; shows the current month and year heading and 'No date selected'; clicking a day button shows that date's long text, sets aria-pressed true on it only, and clicking another day moves the selection; day buttons have full-date accessible names; next and previous month buttons change the heading and keep a selection made in another month; the selected-date text is a polite live region.
HomeView renders one 'Calendar' region after the torus row, with 'No date selected' initially, and the existing sections and accessible names are unchanged.

expectedRedEvidence.expectedFailure: src/lib/calendarMonth does not exist, so the test file fails to import it.
CalendarWidget module does not exist, so the test file fails to import it.
HomeView renders no calendar widget, so no 'Calendar' region is found.

verification.requirement: npm run test:component passes (including component layout validation), and npm run lint and npm run build are clean
